name: com.gameframex.unity.operationclipboard.kuaishouminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Clipboard (KuaiShou Mini Game)
description:
Kuaishou Mini Game clipboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationClipboard. Implements IOperationClipboardManager over the Kuaishou clipboard SDK with callback-based read / write, and self-registers into OperationClipboardRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad via KuaiShouMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD macros are not enabled — referencing means registering). The channel SDK is provided by the target project and the core package never references it. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationClipboard 的快手小游戏粘贴板适配渠道包。基于快手小游戏剪贴板 API 实现回调式读写，由 KuaiShouMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 阶段自注册进主包 OperationClipboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪、注册不发生，引用即注册）。渠道 SDK 由目标工程提供，主包不引用它。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
